subject: API response times exceeding 5 seconds for large database queries
body: Our production integration with the Notion API has become unreliable. We're querying a database with approximately 8,500 rows and experiencing 5-10 second response times. This is causing timeouts in our internal application and our users are reporting errors. We need either performance improvements or higher rate limits to paginate more efficiently.

subject: Offline mode - when is this coming?
body: We've been asking for offline support for 3 years. This is the most upvoted request on your feedback board. Our team works in the field regularly. We've had to keep a Notion + Obsidian hybrid workflow specifically because of this gap. Please give us any timeline at all.

subject: URGENT: Content disappeared during collaborative editing session
body: This morning at 9:15 AM EST, three team members were editing the same page simultaneously. After the session, approximately 2,000 words of content were gone with no recovery option. Version history shows the content existed, then doesn't. This is the third time this has happened in 6 weeks. We need an immediate explanation and a fix. This is a critical business document.

subject: Okta SSO intermittently failing - affecting 180 users
body: Since the update on November 4th, our Okta SAML integration fails approximately 20% of the time. Users get a 401 error and have to retry. Our IT helpdesk is getting 15-20 tickets per day about this. We have checked our Okta config and it hasn't changed. This appears to be a Notion-side issue. Need urgent resolution.

subject: Renewal invoice 43% higher than last year - no communication
body: Just received our renewal invoice for $7,200 — last year it was $5,040. That's a 43% increase. We received zero communication about this change. No email, no in-app notification, nothing. We noticed it when the charge hit our card. Can you explain what changed and why we weren't notified? This makes it very difficult to budget plan.

subject: Mobile app extremely slow - 5-8 second load times
body: The iOS app takes 5-8 seconds to load any page, even simple ones. This is on an iPhone 14 with fast WiFi. The desktop app is fine. We use Notion for quick reference lookups throughout the day and having to wait this long every time makes mobile completely impractical. This has been a problem for at least 6 months.

subject: Accidental public share by non-admin user exposed sensitive documents
body: A non-admin user accidentally toggled a workspace page to 'public on web' and our confidential HR documents were accessible externally for approximately 4 hours before we noticed. The permission model makes it too easy for users to accidentally expose content. We need a confirmation modal, workspace-level sharing restrictions, and an alert when sensitive pages go public.

subject: Search cannot find content inside database cells
body: When I search for a term that exists inside a database table cell, it doesn't appear in results. Only page titles and text blocks are searchable. We store a lot of information in database properties (select fields, text fields) and can never find it via search. This seems like a fundamental limitation. Is there a workaround or is this on the roadmap?

subject: Notion AI doesn't understand my workspace context
body: We pay for Notion AI but it has no awareness of our actual workspace. When I ask it to summarize our Q3 performance, it gives generic responses instead of pulling from our actual Q3 documents. Competitors like Coda have AI that actually queries your data. Are there plans to make Notion AI aware of workspace content? Otherwise it's just a $10/user/month ChatGPT wrapper.

subject: Audit log insufficient for SOC2 and regulatory requirements
body: We are undergoing a SOC2 Type II audit. The current audit log does not capture all required events (page moves, property changes, bulk edits) and doesn't attribute all changes to specific users clearly. Our auditors have flagged this as a gap. We need a comprehensive, exportable audit log that meets enterprise compliance standards. This is a blocker for our renewal.

subject: Salesforce sync breaking weekly - major workflow disruption
body: Our Salesforce-to-Notion sync breaks about once per week, usually after a Notion update. When it breaks, our sales team's CRM data in Notion goes stale and they have to manually cross-check Salesforce. We have 35 sales reps relying on this sync. Each outage causes 1-2 hours of wasted time across the team. Need more reliability and faster support response when this breaks.

subject: Large workspace taking 10+ seconds to load on first access
body: Our workspace has grown to about 50,000 pages over 3 years. Initial load time is now 10-15 seconds. Switching between pages after that is fine, but the cold start is killing our morning workflow. Everyone complains about it in our daily standup. We've optimized everything on our end — this appears to be a fundamental scaling issue on Notion's side.

subject: URGENT: Incident response runbook content lost during edit conflict
body: During an active incident this morning, two on-call engineers were editing our IR runbook simultaneously. After the incident, ~600 words of mitigation steps were missing. Version history is incomplete and we cannot recover. This is a P0 from our side — losing runbook content during incidents is not acceptable for any tool we trust as a source of truth. Please escalate to engineering leadership.

subject: API rate limits killing our customer-facing dashboard
body: We built a customer-facing reporting dashboard powered by the Notion API. We hit the 3 rps average rate limit at ~80 daily active users. Our customers are seeing 429 errors and stale data. We've requested a higher rate limit through your sales team and were told there is no enterprise API tier. We need either a paid uplift or we have to migrate the data layer off Notion.

subject: SCIM deprovisioning not removing access for terminated employees
body: Our SCIM integration is not deprovisioning access for terminated employees reliably. Last audit showed 7 ex-employees still had Notion access weeks after their HRIS termination event fired. This is a serious security finding for us. We need an explanation, a fix, and a way to bulk-audit current SCIM state.

subject: No way to disable public sharing at workspace level
body: After a second accidental public share incident this quarter, we want to disable 'share to web' as a capability for our entire workspace. Admin policy options don't include this. Customer success suggested 'training the team' which is not an acceptable answer for a 280-person organization. We need a workspace-level toggle to disable public sharing.

subject: AI add-on auto-renewed at higher price - no notification
body: Our AI add-on auto-renewed for our 120-seat team at a 25% higher per-seat price than what we signed up for last year. There was no email, no in-app notification, no line item in our renewal quote calling this out. We discovered it on the invoice. We are requesting a credit for the difference and a clearer pricing change notification policy going forward.

subject: Mobile app crashes on large database pages
body: Our 'Customer Accounts' database has ~6,000 rows. Opening the page on iOS reliably crashes the app within 10 seconds. iPhone 15 Pro, latest iOS, latest Notion app. Engineering team has reproduced this on multiple devices. Our field reps need this database on mobile and currently cannot use it at all.

subject: Search results not ranked by relevance for large workspace
body: We have ~22,000 pages. When I search for a specific project name, the top results are unrelated pages that happen to contain the word elsewhere. The page literally titled 'Project Atlas Spec' shows up on page 3. There's no relevance ranking, no recency boost, no 'in title' filter. Search is functionally broken at our scale.

subject: Need EU data residency for new German customers
body: We are landing customers in Germany who require their data to remain in the EU. Notion's current data residency story (multi-region storage) does not satisfy their procurement teams. We've already lost one €40K/year deal due to this. We need a clear path to EU-only data residency or our enterprise contract becomes a sales blocker for our own business.

subject: Database button automations failing silently with no error log
body: We use database button automations to update statuses across linked databases. Roughly 30% of the time they fail silently — the property doesn't update, no error is shown, no log entry. There is no audit of which automations ran or failed. This makes the automation feature unusable for any workflow that matters. Please add an automation execution log.

subject: Jira sync only one-way - need bidirectional
body: The official Jira integration only syncs Jira → Notion. We need updates made in Notion (status changes, due date changes) to flow back to Jira. Our PMs work in Notion, our engineers work in Jira, and right now they have to manually keep both in sync. This is a daily friction. Asking again because the last ticket was closed without resolution.

subject: Figma and Loom embeds break randomly across workspace
body: About once a week, a batch of our embedded Figma frames and Loom videos stop loading and show 'unable to embed'. The fix is to delete and re-paste each one. We have ~400 embeds across our spec docs. This is hours of manual cleanup per month. Looks like an issue with how Notion caches third-party embeds — please investigate.

subject: Guest pricing model unworkable for agency client portals
body: We are a 22-person agency with ~85 client guest accounts across active projects. Our guest seat costs now exceed our member seat costs, which makes no economic sense for our use case. Competitors offer flat-fee guest access or per-workspace pricing. Without a similar model we will move our client portals to Coda at next renewal.

subject: Need template governance for large workspaces
body: Our 350-person workspace has accumulated ~700 templates created by anyone. There's no concept of 'official template', no ownership, no approval workflow, no usage analytics. New hires open random outdated templates and propagate stale patterns. We need an admin-managed template library with approval workflow and analytics.

subject: Notion AI cannot answer questions across workspace content
body: We pay for the AI add-on for our 240-person team. The most common feedback from our pilot is that Notion AI cannot answer questions like 'what did we decide in the Q3 product review' even though that document exists in our workspace. We've shown the team Coda AI doing exactly this. Without workspace-aware AI we will not renew the add-on.

subject: Database with 30K rows essentially unusable
body: Our 'Customer Interactions' database hit 30,000 rows last month. The page now takes 40+ seconds to load, filters time out after ~15 seconds, and the API can't reliably paginate beyond row 10K. Our team has had to split the database into smaller ones, which broke half of our linked references. There needs to be either documented scale limits or actual scale support.

subject: Bulk edit reverted - cannot recover lost property values
body: Yesterday a teammate did a bulk edit on ~400 rows in our project tracker. After the edit, the changes appeared to apply, then reverted ~10 minutes later with no error. Version history shows only the final reverted state, not the bulk-edited state. We've now lost both the original values (overwritten) and the new values (reverted). This is unacceptable for any data tool. Need urgent investigation and a recovery path.
